message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully retrieved the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My next step is to find the common 30-minute slots in their schedules and communicate them to Brad. I have already manually processed their schedules and identified the following potential start times for the meeting:

*   Monday: 09:00, 09:30
*   Tuesday: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
*   Wednesday: 15:00, 15:30
*   Thursday: 10:00
*   Friday: 11:00, 11:30

I will now add this list of available slots to our shared workspace. This will allow Brad to check these times against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor. After I post the message, I will end my session, as I will have completed my part of the task for now and need to wait for Brad's input. This is the most efficient use of my allowed actions per session.

My focus now is on compiling this information into a consolidated list for quick reference.

Monday offers two options, Tuesday also has three, Wednesday two, Thursday just one, and Friday has two as well. I'm now writing this consolidated list to the workspace.
